text:
Priya: Following the postmortem for INC-2026-052 - collecting owners for the tuning playbook (noise reduction, threshold retunes, dedupe rules, paging routing). Putting everything in one thread.
OpsBot: Incident INC-2026-052 closed by team automation at 2026-03-22T22:08:04Z. Postmortem link: /incidents/INC-2026-052.
Ben: I'll pick up the suppression/dedupe work. Plan: run a 14-day backtest and produce a suppression candidate list. ETA: Wed EOD.
Kara: I'll do thresholds (latency/err rate) and create a small Canary dashboard for 24h post-change. Need data access to historical spans > 90d for seasonality.
Leo: I'll own paging policy and rota changes. Proposal: move 3 low-actionable alerts to a "no-page" soft-route and add a 15m coalesce window for the rest.
Priya: Good. Please include test runs and false-positive matrices in the PRs. Tag PRs with label `postmortem/INC-2026-052`.
Ben: First draft suppression rule (dry-run): ```
# suppress repeated RPC connect_timeouts from same instance
if count(error: "rpc_timeout", instance) > 10/min then suppress for 45m
```
Ben: Will run dry-run and post results in this thread (I expect ~2% of alerts would be suppressed).
Kara: Threshold plan:
- compute rolling 30d p95/p99 for `inference.latency.ms` and `request.error_rate`
- suggest new thresholds where p99 > 1200ms OR sudden spike > 3x baseline
I'll drop SQL and graphs by Thu 10:00 PT.
Leo: For paging, I also want to exclude `ci/` and `test-namespace` alerts from paging. I'll add a regex filter to the routing rule.
Priya: Owners summary: dedupe = Ben, thresholds = Kara, paging = Leo, PM follow-up = Priya. Target: all PRs open by 2026-03-26, rollout week of 2026-03-29.
Kara: Question 0: do we want an automated recurrence detector for monthly repeats before we add suppressions? I can prototype a simple score that flags alerts with >6 recurrences in 30 days.
Ben: Yes, let's surface recurring candidates first. I can use that to whitelist/blacklist suppression rules.
Leo: I'll wire the recurrence results into the ops dashboard so we can triage long-term fixes.
Priya: Sequence I want: 1) Kara posts recurrence analysis + threshold candidates (Thu 10:00PT) 2) Ben posts dedupe dry-run (Wed EOD) 3) Leo opens paging config + test rota changes (Fri) 4) Priya opens combined rollout doc and rollback plan (by next Mon).
Kara: Also adding a short rollback auto-run: if noise (alert volume) increases >12% in the 24h after change, auto-revert routing or thresholds. I'll add the metric to the canary dashboard.
Ben: Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/obs-config/pull/509 (WIP). Dry-run logs attached in PR description.
Leo: Branch `noisy-route-remap` created. Will add tests to ensure CI namespaces excluded.
Priya: Please react with :white_check_mark: when PRs are up so I can update the follow-up tracker. I'll also schedule a 20m sync the week after rollout to collect telemetry.
Kara: 44d I'll post the SQL and graphs at 09:45 PT.
Ben: 44d posted dry-run results in PR; suppression looks safe for ~18 alerts/day.
Leo: 44d opened paging PR draft and CI filters included.
Priya: Thanks. If any of you hit blockers (data access, role perms), call it out here and we'll reassign.
Kara: Small blocker 0: need read access to archived logs (prod-logs-90d). Filed infra request INC-ACC-778.
Priya: Noted. I'll escalate.
OpsBot: Reminder created: followup-sync (INC-2026-052) on 2026-03-27T17:00:00Z.
Priya: Closing for now. I'll update the tracker once all PRs are opened.
